testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect wheel display preference choices ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the navigation wheel options dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user opens the big wheel size list ✔ Then it offers Small, Normal and Large ✔ When the user dismisses that list and opens the wheel opacity list ✔ Then it offers 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% ✔ When the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel ✔ Then the options dialog closes and the navigation wheel remains visible
